title: lupinus bartlettianus
intro: Lupinus bartlettianus, commonly known as the Bartlett's lupine, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family. It has been used for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus bartlettianus are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
